description: A by-term resolver WITH a 'default', so an unmapped term reaches the default rather than the null-return rejection. Mapping keys differ in case and in script from some of the terms the cases pass, so exact-match lookup is observable in the rendered text. The 'Arger' entry is spelled with the PRECOMPOSED U+00C4, so a case passing the decomposed A + U+0308 form misses it.
